Personal Statement

Data and AI engineer with a background in physics and astrophysics and more than 20 years of experience across research labs, startups, a multinational, and Atlantic Canada's largest health research system. I build data platforms and AI tooling for medical imaging, have led product and engineering as a startup CTO, and spent my early career integrating and flying NASA balloon payloads from New Mexico and Antarctica.

Communication

Confident and adaptable, with strong oral, written, and presentation skills — comfortable explaining technical work to radiologists, executives, funders, and students.

Leadership

Former startup CTO and R&D program manager who builds productive teams by playing to individual strengths.

Initiative

Self-directed and hands-on — from soldering flight hardware in Antarctica to shipping data platforms in a hospital.
